blocks.text: Accomplished lawyer and acclaimed stand-up comedian Edward Chico is set to once again bring his unmistakable brand of biting humor and witty commentary in “Laugh Control: The Atty. Ed Chico Show,” his upcoming pre-Christmas show at the Newport Performing Arts Theater. Happening this December 17, the show promises to be an unforgettable night of smart, irreverent, and yes, “unimpeachable” Filipino comedy covering a wide array of topics including politics, current affairs, and even Chico’s own legal profession which he is also known to tackle in his own self-deprecating fashion.
